name: What is involved in repairing a leaking outdoor spigot?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in repairing a leaking outdoor spigot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a leaking outdoor spigot typically involves shutting off the water supply, disassembling the faucet, inspecting and replacing worn components like washers, O-rings, or packing. If freezing has occurred, the repair might extend to replacing the entire faucet body or repairing damaged piping. CG Plumbing Solutions ensures the water main is securely shut off and conducts a thorough inspection of both the faucet and the connecting pipe to identify all potential issues before beginning repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair involves shutting off water, disassembling, and replacing worn parts like washers or O-rings. Extensive repairs might replace the whole faucet or damaged pipes.
